properties.name: safeai.chat.erasure.accept-enabled
properties.description: Fail-closed admission gate for chat content erasure.

properties.name: safeai.chat.erasure.executor-enabled
properties.description: Separate physical chat redaction worker gate.

properties.name: safeai.chat.erasure.poll-delay
properties.description: Polling delay of isolated chat erasure worker.

properties.name: safeai.chat.erasure.worker-jdbc-url
properties.description: Dedicated PostgreSQL connection for isolated erasure worker.

properties.name: safeai.chat.erasure.worker-username
properties.description: Dedicated PostgreSQL worker login, never the app login.

properties.name: safeai.chat.erasure.worker-password
properties.description: Dedicated PostgreSQL worker password supplied through secrets.

properties.name: safeai.erasure.requests.enabled
properties.description: R1a case intake only (preview, draft, submit and withdraw); no physical erasure executor. Disabled by default. Do not enable in production before R1a security and migration gates.

properties.name: safeai.erasure.approvals.enabled
properties.description: R1b independent case review only. No destructive execution. Disabled by default.

properties.name: safeai.erasure.review.actor-proof-key
properties.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte R1b DB actor HMAC proof key, provisioned independently into erasure_review_actor_keys_v105. Secret; never commit. Missing or mismatched keys fail closed.
